title: Unrest Erupts Again in France, but This Time, With Less Property Damage
summary_full: After largely peaceful marches on Saturday, clashes broke out in the evening. But a large-scale police presence, 1,000 arrests and the rerouting of protest routes kept a lid on wholesale vandalism.
